text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, tuck your chin in~ Don't look at 
the camera! Eyes straight ahead—and, 
click♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
How does it look? ...Yeah, it's a nice, 
knightly photo. You've been a big help. 
Whenever I try taking it myself, it always 
ends up blurry...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nope, not quite yet. The background and 
natural lighting are perfect, but adding 
filters is a must for that photogenic pop♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's use a beige filter, and add a 
lighting effect... and done.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... It looks like it was taken in a 
photo studio! As expected of Curren-san.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to attach the photo to 
my status report... I'm sure my parents 
will see how dependable I've become.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I could help♪ With such a great 
subject, the photos turned out looking 
super cool.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, not at all. It's only because of 
Curren-san's skill..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! Curren just really wanted to 
take a two-shot with such a wonderful 
knight♪ ...Is that... a no?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu! I don't mind at all. Let's take as 
many as you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're so sweet, Durandal-san~♪ All right 
then, right away—say cheese! *Snap*!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(That picture from earlier and this one 
right now—such a chivalrous knight. 
...I'll set it as my wallpaper later.)
